title: Color Belt · CB14 / M15 · Sheet 1 · Classes and ranks move to Settings; Color Belt keeps a Prices tab
subtitle: Already decided (v1.023, walkthrough 15d option B): things several sections use live in Settings — Classes and ranks becomes Settings’ second part, after Schools, each school’s classes and belt ranks with Add class; Color Belt keeps only what is testing’s own — the three prices, sparring gear and each class’s final award — in a tab. Joint plan with Dashboard core agreed: Color Belt builds it, Dashboard core reviews the Settings fit. Four questions of D6 are left; Question 1 is at the bottom. (Preview screenshots, fake data. The “after” is drawn on top of the real pages from the real class list; nothing in the app is built yet. Addresses are hidden in the pictures.)

items.caption: 1. Testing → Color belt testing → Classes and ranks (admin, Worcester): each class’s ranks with their belt, the belt they test for, the three prices and sparring gear; the last rank tests for the class’s final award. Add class at the top. It follows the top bar’s school (v0.36).
2. Settings today: one part, Schools; admins only — staff see this line.

1. Settings gets a second part, “Classes and ranks”, after Schools: its h2 heading, Add class (outline, as a part’s button) and one gray line; each school’s classes under the school’s name. The same class list and drag order as today, with no prices and no sparring gear; the last rank’s next belt reads “Final award: set in the Prices tab”. Settings ignores the top bar. The layout of the two schools is Question 3.

2. Color belt testing → “Prices” (name: Question 4): the three prices and sparring gear per rank, and each class’s final award on its line, with an edit pencil (admins). No reorder, no Add (classes, ranks and their order are in Settings); it still follows the top bar’s school.

footer:
To decide

Question 1 of 4 · Staff can view Classes and ranks today (v0.40). Settings is admins only. What do staff see after the move?

Today staff (and the shared desk sign-in) open Testing → Classes and ranks and read every class, rank and price, with “View only. Ask an admin to make changes.” (v1.021). After the move, the prices stay in Color Belt’s tab; only the class and belt list goes to Settings, which staff can’t open (they see “Only admins can see Settings.”). Day to day the desk needs the prices (a family asks what testing costs) — and the classes’ days and times are already in the Schedule, which staff can see.

A · Staff get a view-only Settings → Classes and ranks

Staff keep everything they can read today, in its new place. − Settings stops being “admins only”: the account menu must show Settings to staff (that entry is Dashboard core’s change, in AccountMenu.jsx — M17 changes the menu too), and the page needs a staff version. − Two places to look for one school’s rank list (Settings for belts, Color Belt for prices).

B · Settings stays admins only; staff read the Prices tab (view only) Recommended

Recommended. The desk still sees what it uses — every class, rank, price and final award — in the place it already goes (Color belt testing). No account-menu change, no staff version of Settings, Settings keeps its one rule (admins only, v0.135). − Staff lose the “Testing for” column (which belt comes next); the belts are listed in order, and the event’s roster still shows it.

Questions to come, one at a time after Question 1

  1. Question 2: the Schedule’s and Forms’ hints (“Add classes in …”) — plain text pointing to Settings → Classes and ranks, or links that open it (it would get its own address, e.g. #settings/classes-and-ranks; the hints are the new students’ N11).
  2. Question 3: how the two schools show on a page that ignores the top bar — one under the other with the school named (drawn here as the default reading), or a Worcester / Shrewsbury switch inside the part (the shared ChoiceGroup).
  3. Question 4: the Prices tab’s name (drawn as “Prices”).

Not on this sheet: the Add / Edit class and Add / Edit rank dialogs split the same way (Settings keeps name, belt, order and next rank; the Prices tab’s edit keeps the prices, sparring gear and the final award) — drawn after the four answers. No database change is expected (same tables; admins already write them).

Answer Question 1 first (A or B).
